description: Writes a starter DESIGN.md file from the CSS of one public webpage. Best for: a user who gives a website address and wants its colors, fonts, spacing, corner radii and component styles as a DESIGN.md file. Returns: markdown (the DESIGN.md text in the open Google format, YAML tokens then the 8 standard sections), the lint verdict of @google/design.md 0.4.0 on that text, the token counts and the number of stylesheets read. Pass url, such as "https://stripe.com"; a bare host such as "stripe.com" means https. Do not use for: pages behind a login, private or local addresses (localhost, 192.168.x.x), pages that robots.txt disallows, or a DESIGN.md file the user already has (use lint_design_md). Errors: blocked_url, invalid_url, robots_disallowed, fetch_failed and http_error each say what to send next.

include_raw_css.description: When true, adds the concatenated CSS that was read to rawCss. The response gets large, so leave it off unless the user asks for the CSS. Default false.

max_stylesheets.description: How many linked stylesheets to fetch and parse, 1 to 10. Default 5.

url.description: Address of one public webpage, such as "https://stripe.com". A bare host such as "stripe.com" means https. Only public http and https pages work: no login pages, localhost or private addresses.

name: extract_design_md

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

document.description: The extracted tokens, layout regions and rules before they are written as markdown

colors.description: Color roles such as primary and surface, each with value (hex) and an optional description

components.description: Component styles by name, each with an optional selector and a styles map of CSS property to value

elevation.description: Box shadows none, sm, md and lg as CSS values

meta.description: name, version, description, sourceUrl and extractedAt (ISO 8601) of the extracted file

radius.description: Corner radii none, sm, md, lg and full as CSS lengths; written as the rounded tokens

regions.description: Layout regions by id, each with purpose, selector and rule

rules.description: Usage rules, each with id, summary and detail

spacing.description: baseUnit (such as 4px) and scale (spacing steps as CSS lengths)

typography.description: families (font family names by role) and scale (type styles with fontFamily, fontSize, lineHeight, fontWeight)

lint.description: The official @google/design.md linter's verdict on markdown

path.description: Token path the finding is about, such as colors.primary

rule.description: Rule name of the official linter, such as broken-ref or contrast-ratio

markdown.description: DESIGN.md in the open format (YAML tokens, then the 8 sections), ready to save

tokenCounts.description: How many tokens of each kind were found on the page

rawCss.description: The concatenated CSS that was read; present only when include_raw_css is true

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Extract a DESIGN.md file from a public webpage
